company.name: AVIA Distribution SA
company.distributes: Station shop range with biscuits, chocolate and snacks (Pringles, Zweifel chips, Swiss chocolate), ice cream, drinks and everyday groceries
company.channels_supplied: Its own AVIA station shops in western Switzerland (for example Carouge and Cartigny), alongside AVIA stations with SPAR shops
what_they_do_well: Runs AVIA stations with shops across Vaud, Geneva and Valais, opening the first AVIA hydrogen station in Puidoux in 2023.
company.fit_rationale: AVIA member for French-speaking Switzerland that runs its own AVIA-branded station shops, whose shop pages list biscuits, chocolate and chips from other brands. Diablo's chocolate bars, biscuits and wafers fit that impulse shelf. Shop count is not stated on its website, so it sits in tier 3.

company.name: Bieler Sport
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Sports nutrition shelf with energy bars and gels from Hammer, Sponser and Winforce
company.channels_supplied: Its own stores in Bonaduz and Chur and its website
what_they_do_well: Family run specialist for running, biking and Nordic skiing since 1986, with stores in Bonaduz and Chur.
company.fit_rationale: A family run running, biking and Nordic ski retailer founded in 1986 with two stores in Graubünden and a sports nutrition shelf from three brands. Small reach; individual bar products are not listed on its home page.
